      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "reviewer withdrew concern after MSVCRT support was dropped and author removed workaround",

      "other_replies": [],

      "status_by_id": "c:5714437254",

      "type": "suggestion",

      "status": "accepted",

      "status_note": "author agreed to switch to prose attribution in future commits",

      "fix_pushed": false,
